cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31)
project(StaticPluginApp LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(iiSDKCore 0.20 CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Runtime)
add_library(alpha MODULE EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL App/Plugins/alpha.cpp)
add_library(beta MODULE EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL App/Plugins/beta.cpp)
foreach(target IN ITEMS alpha beta)
    target_compile_features(${target} PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE iiSDKCore::Runtime)
endforeach()
add_executable(static_app App/main.cpp)
target_compile_features(static_app PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
target_link_libraries(static_app PRIVATE iiSDKCore::Runtime)
